Defined by courage and humility, Ip Man, whose fighting skills are revered all over China, rises to the fore front. Upon refusing to teach his martial arts to the invading Japanese soldiers, he is forced to fight for the honor of his country in a series of battles that will culminate in a kill-or-be-killed showdown with Japan’s greatest fighter.

programme.title: THE WAWIES (2025)
programme.desc: Wawaland is a tiny world within planet Earth. So small and light that it gets carried away by the wind. Right now, it could be flying over Tokyo, Paris, or the Atlantic Ocean, completely unseen by humans. In this magical place live The Wawies—chubby and curious beings who are always asking questions and trying to make sense of the world around them and ours. Through Sha’s far-away glasses, the Wawies can observe how humans behave on Earth and apply what they learn in their own world, sparking endless adventures that teach them, entertain them, help them explore their surroundings, and listen to themselves. They always stick together and never leave anyone behind. For example, this season, you might find them competing in their own version of Wawachef,” escaping from some not-so-friendly monkeys, deciding to ban rules in their world forever, trying to calm down some feisty ants, training their patience to care for a garden, or figuring out which costume party is more fun: Halloween or Carnival. With each adventure, Sha, Opo, Aca, Bow, and Tok strive to understand, grow, and have fun. And along the way, they’ll unintentionally create their own set of rules to live in a place where respect and harmony with their surroundings are key. With its playful and cheerful tone, Wawaland seeks to show children a different way of seeing things—helping them appreciate the world around them and, most importantly, themselves.

programme.title: THE WAWIES (2025)
programme.desc: Wawaland is a tiny world within planet Earth. So small and light that it gets carried away by the wind. Right now, it could be flying over Tokyo, Paris, or the Atlantic Ocean, completely unseen by humans. In this magical place live The Wawies—chubby and curious beings who are always asking questions and trying to make sense of the world around them and ours. Through Sha’s far-away glasses, the Wawies can observe how humans behave on Earth and apply what they learn in their own world, sparking endless adventures that teach them, entertain them, help them explore their surroundings, and listen to themselves. They always stick together and never leave anyone behind. For example, this season, you might find them competing in their own version of Wawachef,” escaping from some not-so-friendly monkeys, deciding to ban rules in their world forever, trying to calm down some feisty ants, training their patience to care for a garden, or figuring out which costume party is more fun: Halloween or Carnival. With each adventure, Sha, Opo, Aca, Bow, and Tok strive to understand, grow, and have fun. And along the way, they’ll unintentionally create their own set of rules to live in a place where respect and harmony with their surroundings are key. With its playful and cheerful tone, Wawaland seeks to show children a different way of seeing things—helping them appreciate the world around them and, most importantly, themselves.

programme.title: Go Astro Boy Go!
programme.desc: Los cultivos de maíz de una aldea sudamericana están siendo devorados por una plaga de termitas, y Maurice es sorprendido robando el queso favorito del Dr. Blunt. El Dr. Blunt confina a Maurice en su jaula con la vana esperanza de rehabilitarlo. El Equipo Astro intenta varios métodos orgánicos infructuosos para salvar las cosechas de la aldea, y Astro y Suzu piensan que es divertido darle a Astro-Kitty los trabajos más sucios y malolientes. Astro-Kitty se rebela, se pone su mini-traje robótico y se une a la colonia de termitas, donde se gana el corazón de la reina y se convierte en su rey. Astro-Kitty redime su acto temporal de deserción del Equipo Astro salvando a Suzu de morir ahogada y encontrando un alojamiento alternativo para las termitas, Maurice, por otro lado, prefiere una pierna de pavo a la rehabilitación.

programme.title: Borowski y el mar silencioso (2026)
programme.desc: When a body is found on the beach, Borowski and Sahin are confronted with many leads. Three young climate activists are dead, and a mysterious AI influencer known as Zenaida has a strange hold over their community. While Borowski goes undercover to get close to the group, Sahin uncovers a case of digital manipulation on a terrifying scale.

programme.title: Borowski: Crimen en Wacken y el Misterio del Niño (2026)
programme.desc: A dead infant is found in a car park near Kiel. An entrance wristband leads Borowski and Sahin to the quiet village of Wacken in Schleswig-Holstein, days before over 80,000 fans descend for one of the world's biggest heavy metal festivals. Trails lead to a Ukrainian surrogate mother and a mysterious couple whose obsessive search for perfect happiness has driven them to dark extremes.

programme.title: Behringer y los Muertos
programme.desc: En Bamberg, un peligroso incendiario aterroriza a la ciudad. Cuando una autocaravana explota, el ataque deja un hombre muerto y a una joven gravemente herida: la hija de la alcaldesa. Desesperada por respuestas, la madre exige resultados y presiona al equipo investigador.

programme.title: Go Astro Boy Go!
programme.desc: No todo es lo que parece cuando el Team Astro acude al rescate de un niño (Moé) atacado por cuervos en un parque infantil. Pronto descubren que los pájaros no iniciaron la pelea, fue Moé quien lisió a un cuervo con su tirachinas, creyendo que la "criatura sucia y asquerosa" infectó a su gato con una enfermedad. Ahora los cuervos, liderados por la genio de las trampas Trixie, están decididos a que Moé se enfrente a su destino en el Tribunal de los Cuervos. Su única esperanza de absolución depende de que el Team Astro demuestre que actuó por ignorancia y no por malicia, y de que el Dr. Blunt demuestre que realmente es un brillante zoólogo y cirujano veterinario.

programme.title: Deer and Deer Hunting
programme.desc: Daniel Schmidt and Zach Haas dive into the topic of Epizootic Hemorrhagic Disease (EHD), exploring what it is, how it spreads, and the impact it has on whitetail deer populations. Daniel then takes viewers back ten years to a memorable hunt in Kansas where he harvested a buck that had survived EHD. The remarkable deer carried lasting signs of its battle with the disease, including a severely deformed club foot believed to be the result of surviving the infection. This episode offers a fascinating look at deer resilience and provides hunters with a deeper understanding of one of the most significant diseases affecting whitetails today.

The transcript emphasizes that managing pressure is a learned skill, supported by consistent routines and trust in dependable equipment like Winchester AA shotshells. - As the two champions train, mentor the next generation, and reflect on the journeys that shaped their careers, the episode celebrates more than trophies. With Kim's Olympic legacy and Desi's Hall of Fame induction, the passion, perseverance, and commitment to excellence that continue to inspire shooters across the country.

programme.desc: Jessie ya está harta de los insultos, el acoso y las acusaciones de su novio Dakota, y quiere que pare antes de perder su trabajo. Larynee creía que su prometido Steven era el indicado, pero ahora no está tan segura y sospecha que la engaña.

programme.title: Jerry Springer
programme.desc: Danny planea dejar a la madre de su hijo por una stripper; Richard le confiesa a su prometida que la engañó mientras ella estaba encerrada; Dorreon quiere poner fin a su relación.

programme.title: Jerry Springer
programme.desc: Jerry tiene 58 años y ha pasado por tres cambios importantes. Actualmente está felizmente comprometido con una mujer que se llama Joy y habla de su pasada confusión en cuanto al género.

programme.title: Jerry Springer
programme.sub-title: Voy a recuperar a mi novio
programme.desc: En el Show de Jerry Springer de hoy, una batalla de novias. Nicole le da un ultimátum a su amante: o la dejas o me pierdes. ¡Jerry ve cómo saltan chispas en el programa de hoy!

programme.title: Jerry Springer
programme.desc: Las formas controladoras del novio de Morgan la han llevado a recurrir a su primo; Hannah hace todo lo posible para saber dónde está su novio; Ebony quiere que su novio dé un paso adelante y sea un ejemplo positivo para sus hijos.

programme.title: Jerry Springer
programme.desc: Un hombre quiere volver con su ex novia; una mujer busca terminar dos relaciones; un hombre intenta salvar su matrimonio.

programme.title: Séptimo Día
programme.desc: En Colombia, las muertes por accidentes viales por exceso de velocidad y embriaguez, siguen creciendo. A pesar de las tragedias, muchos conductores iresponsables quedan impunes, las leyes no logran frenar la creciente cifra de víctimas.

programme.title: Séptimo Día
programme.desc: Dos hermanos desaparecieron misteriosamente mientras la familia Caicedo se repartía la herencia.

programme.title: Séptimo Día
programme.desc: En Funza, Cundinamarca, más de 2000 personas fueron engañadas por una asociación que prometía viviendas. Desde estafas hasta terrenos inapropiados, el sueño de tener casa propia se convirtió en una amarga pesadilla de promesas rotas.

programme.title: Séptimo Día
programme.desc: En Ibagué, mujeres atrapadas por decisiones estéticas arriesgadas enfrentan consecuencias devastadoras. En busca de justicia, las huellas de un pasado oculto salen a la luz, mientras el miedo y el dolor de las víctimas desafían el sistema.

programme.title: Séptimo Día
programme.desc: Jhon Fredy y Miguel Ángel adoptaron una niña, pero el Colegio Americano de Bogotá los rechazó por ser una familia homoparental. Fabio Meneses y Xiomy Díaz sufrieron en terapias de conversión. Andrés Felipe Arboleda fue asesinado por discriminación en Caldas.

programme.title: Séptimo Día
programme.desc: Un productor de Séptimo Día graba cómo en un bar en Bucaramanga se alquilan niños para mendicidad. Yiriam y Franklin, migrantes venezolanos, pierden a su hija menor tras dejarla al cuidado de Franyeli, quien es detenida por mendicidad ajena. La Policía y el ICBF intervienen en varios casos similares.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: Giovanny Padilla, registrador en La Jagua de Ibirico, fue asesinado el 1 de enero de 2018 en Valledupar. Dos jóvenes, Emanuel Castro y Jesús Sánchez, lo torturaron para robarle. Ambos fueron capturados y condenados.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: El asesinato del niño Luis Santiago en Chía (Cundinamarca).

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: En 2014, en Santana, Huila, Jorge Cangrejo fue secuestrado y baleado en la cabeza por sus captores, quienes lo enterraron creyéndolo muerto. Milagrosamente sobrevivió y se convirtió en aliado clave de las autoridades para identificar a los responsables. Dos victimarios permanecen detenidos, acusados de tentativa de homicidio, porte ilegal de armas y secuestro simple agravado, enfrentando hasta 40 años de prisión.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: Arauca se conmociono con el triple homicidio cometido al parecer por Jairo Enrique Vargas Maldonado, de 44 años de edad, Secretario de un juzgado de Arauca, acusado de asesinar a su esposa y sus dos hijos de 6 y 14 años de edad.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: En 2009, desaparece Lía Patricia Nasser, estudiante de derecho de 26 años en Barranquilla. Entre los sospechosos: un compañero de colegio, su novio y la exnovia de su esposo. Tras descartar la hipótesis inicial, la investigación llevó a la captura de Eduardo Osa, compañero universitario, cuya culpabilidad quedó demostrada. La necropsia reveló asfixia mecánica. Osa aceptó los cargos y fue condenado a 26 años por homicidio y ocultamiento de pruebas.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: Deibis Mildred y Adolfo González formaron una familia y un negocio exitoso de confecciones en Riohacha. En 2008, Adolfo fue asesinado en su casa, un crimen inicialmente sin resolver. Tres años después, las sospechas recayeron sobre Deibis Mildred, señalada de planear el homicidio junto a un amante para cobrar un seguro de vida. Fue condenada a 40 años de cárcel como coautora del asesinato.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: Olga Lucía Gaviria y su hija María Ángel fueron asesinadas en Medellín en 2010. El padrastro, Edilson de Jesús Taborda, fue condenado a 60 años por celos enfermizos tras pruebas forenses que lo vincularon al doble homicidio.

programme.title: Juez Mom
programme.desc: Wilbur y su esposa, Lucia, están demandando a la hermana de Wilbur, Jennifer, por $200,000 después de que su hijo quedó fuera del testamento de su abuela.

programme.title: Juez Mom
programme.desc: Mario está demandando a la psíquica del vecindario, Lydia, por $30,000 y la imposición negligente de angustia emocional después de prometer eliminar su maldición ... por una tarifa.

programme.title: Juez Mom
programme.desc: Ariana García, de 19 años, está demandando a sus padres por angustia emocional y abuso, alegando que la negativa de sus padres a reconocer y respetar su privacidad y sus límites emocionales la ha llevado a perder amigos, confianza y negocios lucrativos como influencer de viajes.

programme.title: Juez Mom
programme.desc: Michelle está demandando a Michael y Nuri por negligencia y pérdida comercial después de que su spa de alta gama se dañó cuando los lechones de Michael y Nuri fueron liberados y se volvieron locos en su negocio.

programme.title: Los Informantes
programme.desc: Hace 21 años, paramilitares asesinaron a 60 personas en la masacre de El Salado. Jairo Castillo, alias 'Pitirri', ex paramilitar y testigo clave, acusa a Enilce López, "La Gata", de participar en el crimen. Su testimonio ha enviado a varios a prisión, incluyendo revelaciones sobre el asesinato de la fiscal Yolanda Paternina. Hoy, exiliado en Canadá, Pitirri vive bajo amenazas de muerte por sus declaraciones.

programme.title: Los Informantes
programme.desc: Tres historias: Patricia Osorio busca justicia tras el suicidio de su hijo Daniel, quien denunció abuso sexual por parte de un cura antes de morir. Mujeres ciegas se convierten en examinadoras táctiles, usando su sentido del tacto para detectar cáncer de mama. Y un profesor francés de 90 años dona su fortuna a mujeres que dejaron la prostitución, encontrando un nuevo hogar junto a ellas.

programme.title: Los Informantes
programme.desc: La pandemia disparó la violencia intrafamiliar en Colombia, con 360 feminicidios en 2020. En respuesta, el psicólogo Raúl Suárez lidera escuelas de "nuevas masculinidades", inspiradas en el feminicidio de Maira Barahona en 2016. La iniciativa Bochica enseña a hombres crianza, tareas domésticas y masculinidades no violentas a través de talleres, buscando romper estereotipos de género desde la infancia.

This clash of titans proves why these two programs are the gold standard of collegiate pickleball, where every "point two" earned is a grueling step toward national history.

programme.desc: Competitors need to hold their own in this week’s trial, King of the Castle, where they must defend a circle in centre of the arena against the unforgiving house robots. How many will survive to make it to the semi-finals?

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: House robot, Shunt goes head-to-head with the competitors. It’s his job to remove the competitors from the ring by any means necessary in this week’s trial, Sumo. Will Shunt do the house robots proud, or will the competitors give him the slip?

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: Even more barrels are stacked up, only to be knocked down by a competitor in another Pinball Warrior. After a one-sided fight, a unanimous decision from the judges decides the victor of this week’s heat finals.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: This week’s special event has legs. The Walker Battle special featured robots that do not use wheels or tracks as locomotion battling it out, do they stand a chance against the house robots?

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: Half-way through the heats and Pinball Warrior returns to Robot Wars as another robot comes to test their aim and score against the house robots. The arena claims another robot as the knockout competitions march on.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: The last robot football of The Third Wars in this week’s special. A spot in the final isn’t the only thing the heat final can offer one of the competitors this week.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: The sixth Pinball warrior run introduces another competitor to test their skills against the targets, and the house robots. In the knockouts, the house robots are being exploited as the competitors over-crowd the CPZ zones.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: We see more teams from around the UK bringing in their unique, sometimes amusing, sometimes terrifying robots to battle against each other. Sergeant Bash’s flamethrower is put to good use in the knockouts.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: Walker Battle returns as the contestants for this week’s special prepare to put their best foot forward against the other legged robots. A competitor makes the house robots sweat in the knockouts.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: Karma comes for one of the competitors as the Semi-Finals commence in spectacular fashion. There are no specials this week as the knockout battles take priority in deciding who will win the crown.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: More heat winners are pitted against each other in knockout competition. The robots attempt to ram, flip and burn their way to the finals, all while trying to avoid the house robots.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: This is what it’s been building up to, The Grand Final is here. Which of the successful semi-finalists will be crowned champion of Robot Wars: The Third Wars?

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.sub-title: The Third Wars - First World Championship
programme.desc: Initially released on VHS and broadcast on TV a year later, the World Championship featured sixteen robots from eleven different countries. A straight knockout competition would decide which robot would be known as the World Champion.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: The wars begin yet again, competitors can only qualify by destroying or outsmarting their opponents, and doing their best to stay out of the house robots way. Sumo and Pinball Warrior will test the robots grit and accuracy.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: María exige que su marido reciba ayuda psicológica, está obsesionado con las caricaturas pornográficas. Mónica acusa a su novio de darle pastillas abortivas, pero él asegura que ella miente.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Vendida antes de nacer; El próximo asesino en serie
programme.desc: A Julieta la contratan como madre subrogada y tras dar a luz, ella se niega a entregar al niño. Vivian le exige a su esposo que corra de la casa a su hijastro, lo considera un asesino.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: La rumana, meditación orgásmica; Niño no sabe de padres separados
programme.desc: Alexandra quiere un sexo más placentero, por eso pide que su esposo aprenda meditación orgásmica. Yesica exige el divorcio y la custodia de su hijo; aunque están separados, aún vive con Noel.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Mamá abusadora fuera; Me niego amor por premonición
programme.desc: Cuando era pequeña, su madre la vendió como esclava sexual. Ahora solo quiere vengarse. Rodrigo, novio de Celeste, tuvo una relación con la gemela de su pareja. Ella muere y él quiere terminar.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Propuesta cibernética del nerd; Con cáncer terminal y un ...
programme.desc: Paola pide el divorcio, su joven marido es un nerd que pasa todo el día conectado a la computadora. Juan tiene solo 16 años y padece de un cáncer terminal, solo quiere cumplir con un sueño.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Marido de papá hereda; Madre humilla hijos en FB
programme.desc: Angelina pide invalidar el testamento de su padre, quien le dejó todos sus bienes a su pareja gay. Una madre castiga a sus hijos y comparte las imágenes en internet; ellos se sienten humillados.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Quinceañera pompis y chichis; Hija de 17 casada con haitiano
programme.desc: Mariana quiere la custodia de su hermana menor porque su madre insiste en regalarle una cirugía plástica. Es una niña y se casa sin permiso con un negro haitiano porque su madre es racista.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Amante embarazada y loca; Agente inmobiliario se adueñó de casa
programme.desc: Jack tiene un romance con Angélica y la embaraza. Ahora la difama para quedarse con el bebé. Sofía comete el error de tener sexo en una de las casas que ella vende; el dueño lo graba todo.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: El vende esperma; Tres hijos enfermos, madre sin papeles
programme.desc: Gabriela descubre que su esposo vende su esperma a mujeres desesperadas por quedar embarazadas. Gilma quiere que su esposo autorice la salida de sus hijos del país y de la pesadilla americana.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Madre obsesionada con hija; Llegó la hora de partir
programme.desc: Luisa pide internar a su madre, afirma que se ha vuelto loca y está obsesionada con ser idéntica a ella. Ángela le exige a Rocío, su mamá, no desconectar a su padre, quien se encuentra en coma.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Cincuenta mil dólares del jefe para Hawái; Santa esperma
programme.desc: Venecia, acosada por su jefe, acepta dinero por su silencio, pero detalles del acuerdo se filtran en internet. Héctor se considera un apóstol con la misión de traer al mundo al hijo de Dios.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Apuñaló con destornillador; Salchicha morena por gato
programme.desc: Sale de un hospital psiquiátrico y le pide a la doctora Polo que la ayude a recuperar a su hija. Valeria le sugiere a David usar una crema para aumentar el tamaño de su pene, y termina lastimado.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Hipnotizado o embrujado; Por una firma prenupcial
programme.desc: No puede tener sexo con su marido porque la exesposa le hizo brujería. Raúl exige que Diana le pague por los gastos de boda que canceló al enterarse de que debía firmar un contrato prenupcial.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Sexo a la portuguesa; Máquina paga renta
programme.desc: Rodrigo y Liliana llevan a su casa a una chica portuguesa para tener sexo en trío, pero él se siente desplazado. Una joven, que vive con sus suegros, graba videos porno en vivo; quieren echarla.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Inocencia burlada; Amante embarazada y loca: Parte 2
programme.desc: Adriana quiere quitarle a su cuñada la custodia de su hija, la perdió años atrás. La doctora Polo le pide a esta mujer los exámenes médicos para determinar qué hacer con la criatura que espera.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Vivir con tía y mamá; Hijo le entró a batazos
programme.desc: Rocío quiere recuperar la custodia de su hija, pero la niña no desea vivir con ella. Bárbara se siente culpable porque perdió al bebé que esperaba cuando su hijo la golpeó en la barriga con un bate.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: El muñeco de Bruselas: Herencia por cuidados
programme.desc: Sebastián exige la custodia de la hija que tiene con Patricia. Sospecha que la madre abusa de ella. Juan Manuel cuidó de su madre enferma y tras su muerte, su hermana quiere sacarlo de la casa.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Los morenos si saltan; Aborto en nombre del arte
programme.desc: Javier adopta a una niña de raza negra y la obliga a entrenar para convertirla en una deportista millonaria. Ligia es una artista y usa sus abortos para expresar su arte poco convencional.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Se drogan para estudiar; La impostora
programme.desc: Para obtener mejores calificaciones en la universidad usa drogas regularmente. Andrés exige anular su matrimonio con Patricia y la custodia de su hijo. Ella se casó con una identidad falsa.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Enano como bebé; Trasplante en coma
programme.desc: En su empresa, usan enanos que actúan como bebés para enseñar a los padres cómo criar a sus hijos. Mario exige que se cumpla la voluntad de su hermano, ser desconectado y donar sus órganos.

programme.title: Caso cerrado

programme.title: Sacrificio de Mujer
programme.desc: Enzo le dice a Vicky que quiere terminar su relación porque está enamorado de Milagros. Ella trata de convencerlo diciéndole todo el amor que siente por él, pero Enzo insiste en estar enamorado de Milagros, entonces Victoria se desespera y le dice que va a luchar por él. Amada lo cita Germán a su casa y le ordena que realice un atentado en contra de Clemencia Talamonti Clemencia citó a Luis Francisco en un lugar rodeado de vagabundos, que es el sitio en donde la dejaron abandonada a ella.

programme.title: Para Verte Mejor
programme.desc: Luego de que Cristóbal se enterara la verdad acerca de que su Ana era la misma Ana de la historia de amor de Guillermo, rompe su relación con ella, por lo que Marilda y Guillermo encuentran la oportunidad de volver con sus respectivos amores. Pero Onofre le aconseja a Cristóbal que no se separe, y vuelve al ruedo cuando le perdona a Ana la mentira, y le pide nuevamente que se case con él. Mientras que Venancio continúa en la búsqueda del asesino por el envenenado del acotamiento, otra muerte sucumbe al condominio: Diego, el vecino del cuarto piso, apareció sin vida en su apartamento por presunta muerte natural.

programme.title: Episodio 114 (2026)
programme.desc: Wilker y Yubiri tienen su día de amor. Juan Diego está en la casa de Bienvenida buscando a Yubiri. Bienvenida se preocupa porque ella pensaba que estaba en la agencia. Pero entonces todos piensan que está con Solymar pero esta llega en ese preciso momento buscándola. Fabián | Junior | Olegario y Pastor están jugando dominó. Fabián vuelve con lo de Finita y de repente todos se le quedan viendo porque tiene dos tremendos cachos. Finita le cuenta a Ana lo de Armando.

programme.title: El Árbol de Gabriel
programme.desc: Gabriel le dice a Magdalena que con ella es diferente que se está enamorando pero ella no le cree nada y piensa que con todas es igual. Valentina le cuenta a Epicúreo toda la historia de su hija y le confirma que es Julieta Fernández, la hija de Efraín y Ana Belén. Ana habla por celular con Julieta y le dice que hubo un error, que ella no hablo con el doctor Salas, que es su mamá pero Julieta no confía plenamente y luego cuando llega a la casa encuentra unas fotos raras y se dedica a averiguar que es lo que pasa. Ricardo acuerda con Julieta que publicará en “La Deslenguada” que lo de Magdalena y Gabriel fueron rumores infundados pero con una condición, que vaya a la casa con Jamer y le averigüe todo sobre Magdalena Miranda.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Ricardo busca consejo en Manuela tras la muerte de Celia. Ella le sugiere mudarse con sus hijos, mientras Jade insulta a Benjamín tratándolo como Néstor Cordido. En el cementerio, Elizabeth y Moisés sufren por la pérdida. María del Pilar anuncia su embarazo a René y Gustavo, generando dudas sobre la paternidad de Marcelo. Finalmente, Hortensia y Benjamín planean viajar con Glorita, y Cecilia regresa al hato para organizar el futuro de sus sobrinos tras hallar sobres escritos por Celia.

programme.title: Pecado de Amor
programme.desc: Rosa expulsa furiosamente a Consuelo y Blanca del hospital. Carmen Rosa cuenta a Rosa que aceptó la ayuda de Erasto por desesperación. José Luis enfrenta a Erasto en la fiesta del gimnasio y es expulsado por seguridad. Carlos propone a Marisela ayudarla con su alcoholismo. Vilma orquesta el secuestro de Leticia mediante delincuentes contratados. Alejandro le confiesa a José Luis que se mudará a casa de los Alamo para estar cerca de Rosa. Natalia pacta con criminales para hacerle daño a alguien, complicando aún más la red de intrigas.

programme.title: El Árbol de Gabriel
programme.desc: Gabriel le dice a Magdalena que con ella es diferente que se está enamorando pero ella no le cree nada y piensa que con todas es igual. programme.title: MOD SUN Interview: Walk With Me | SPIN Cover Story
programme.desc: No doubt MOD’s lived many lives since Happy To Be Here was first published in 2015, stating that he feels fortunate to have accomplished so much of what he’d set out to do. His main goal is to keep evolving.

programme.title: Gil Scott-Heron - Black Wax (2023)
programme.desc: BLACK WAX is a musical-political entertainment film produced and directed by Robert Mugge. It centers on the late African American poet-singer-songwriter Gil Scott-Heron - the man Melody Maker called the most dangerous musician alive and many dubbed the forefather of rap music - and his Midnight Band.

programme.title: SPIN COVER STORY yungblud: "walk with me"
programme.desc: If Yungblud led a cult, many would join - even those who fancy themselves hard to persuade. He has an orbit, an aura, an affability that is borderline intoxicating. You can experience it for yourself during our walk with Yungblud through the Sunset Strip, from the Viper Room to the Rainbow Bar and Grill – watch Yungblud share some incredible stories and a Dr Pepper

programme.title: Looking for Johnny: The Legend of Johnny Thunders (2023)
programme.desc: Johnny Thunders was the legendary hard-living rock n roll guitarist who inspired glam-metal, punk and the music scene in general. Looking For Johnny is a 90-minute film that documents Thunders career from his beginnings to his tragic death in 1991. The film examines his career as a member of the New York Dolls, the punk scene with The Heartbreakers in New York City and London and much more.

programme.title: SPIN Presents: Trailers From Hell
programme.desc: From Amadeus the worlds first rockstar to The Beatles and Elvis, Hollywood has always remembered "When Rock Was Young"

programme.title: LoudQUIETloud: A Film About the Pixies (2023)
programme.desc: loudQUIETloud follows the rehearsals and the warm-up shows for the full-fledged, sold-out Pixies reunion tour. It also catalogs, in the cinema-verite style of the Rolling Stones' Gimme Shelter, the less glamorous side of the touring band lifestyle, getting as close to this enigmatic act as anyone is ever likely to get. The Pixies have a once-in-a-lifetime chance at rock n roll redemption.

programme.title: Until The Light Takes Us (2023)
programme.desc: Until The Light Takes Us tells the story of black metal. Part music scene and part cultural uprising, black metal rose to worldwide notoriety in the mid-nineties when a rash of suicides, murders, and church burnings accompanied the explosive artistic growth and output of a music scene that would forever redefine what heavy metal is and what it stands for.

programme.title: Brent Owens Unwraps Mauritius
programme.desc: Arriving in beautiful Mauritius Brent has his first taste of their curry. The Indian population has had a huge influence on the cuisine, but Mauritian curries are unique. Brent meets with Chef Vance to learn the distinctly Mauritian secrets to making curry as he's never made it before. Inspired by his previous trip to South Africa and the distinct textures and tastes of the Mauritian curry he decides to try his own hand at a fusion bunny chow. Heading into the local markets he overcomes language barriers as he struggles to source the ingredients. Finally, baguette in hand, he heads of to the famous colonial house, turned museum, Chateau De LaBourdonnais, where he cooks up at curry amazing feast under the tropical sun and mango trees.

programme.title: Brent Owens Unwraps Mauritius
programme.desc: Brent starts his day with some adrenaline pumping sea karting on the West Coast of the Island. He then heads to the home of Manuella to have an Otentik Creole experience with her and her family. A mix of African and European cuisines influenced by Asia, Creole cuisine is a delicious, colorful melting pot of flavours and Manuella teaches Brent just how to blend these notes to create a unique dish. Tasty creole food and too much rum later Brent is having a ball. The next morning Brent hits the markets to get his ingredients for his creole inspired dish. Heading back to the Ravenala hotel he has a refresher before cooking up his own creole creation on the Riviera Riverside.

programme.title: Brent Owens Unwraps Mauritius
programme.desc: Mauritius is a multi-ethnic, multilingual and multicultural society. After chatting to his guide, Denis, about his Indian heritage Brent is curious to get to know more about the unique Hindu culture of Mauritius. Travelling deep into the heart of the island he heads to Ganga Talao, a sacred crater lake situated in a secluded mountain area where a temple dedicated to Lord Shiva brings in hundreds of pilgrims every day. There he meets with Priest Dayal who takes him on a tour of Hindu culture and beliefs, opening Brent's eyes to a fascinating part of this multifaceted island. Being ever the adrenalin junky, Brent isn't willing to let the rain put a dampener on his planned quad biking safari. Speeding through the pouring rain, Brent heads to the top of a mountain in the Domaine De L'Etoile Réserve, in hopes of catching a glimpse of the fabled view. He then returns to his apartment and is warmed up by some tasty fusion Indian cooking using the Mauritian staple, Okra.

programme.title: Brent Owens Unwraps Mauritius
programme.desc: The French are famous for their haute cuisine with its extravagant presentations and complex techniques. After swimming with wild dolphins Brent meets with Michael Scioli, head chef at the prestigious hotel, Le Constance Prince Maurice on the east coast of the Island. Chef Michael shows him how to prepare a specialized French seafood dish using ingredients straight from the hotel's garden. Seeing as you can never have too much adventure, Brent then tries out fly and dive boarding (mainly dive) which is essentially a water powered jet pack. After an afternoon of fun, he limps into the hotel veggie garden to pick some ingredients for his own feast of French fusion prawns and coconut heart salad as the sun sets on anther beautiful day in paradise.

programme.title: Brent Owens Unwraps Mauritius
programme.desc: Brent starts his day with an undersea walk before heading to Port Louis to meet Lloyd in Chinatown. A massive archway welcomes him onto the busy Chinatown streets and Brent and Lloyd whet their appetites with some Chinese street food. The Chinese influence on Mauritian food has been huge and there have been more than a few fusion dishes to come out of their Chinatown. Brent and Lloyd head to a local Chinese restaurant to try a popular dish that is unique to Mauritius, a Bol Renverse, an "upside-down bowl". After a delicious lunch Lloyd has a treat planned for Brent. He takes him to the Kwan Tee Pagoda, the oldest Pagoda in Mauritius and believed to be the oldest in the Southern Hemisphere. After a magical day Brent head's back to his hotel inspired and ready to cook up a storm. The next day Brent goes in search of ingredients in a local Chinese supermarket and then heads to a peaceful garden to cook his mustard pork with a twist.

programme.title: Brent Owens Unwraps Mauritius
programme.desc: Sugar is commonly known on the island as the Mauritian Miracle, having once been the backbone of Mauritius's economy. Brent visits L'Adventure du Sucre museum and gets a fascinating look at how the Mauritian history is tightly intertwined with sugar. He then heads in to the fields to for some fun cutting cane before meeting up with Chef Oliver and who shows Brent just how much Mauritians love sugar and spice. Brent then heads out to the stunning and exclusive island, Ile Des Deux Cocos, for some snorkeling in a marine sanctuary and then cooks up his own Mauritian tropical desert on a remote coral beach.

programme.title: Brent Owens Unwraps Mauritius
programme.desc: Arriving at the stunning resort of LUX* Belle Mare, Brent is amazed by their stylish, contemporary spin on luxury hospitality. Surrounded by tropical gardens and pristine white beaches, this is what everyone imagines Mauritius to be and more. He meets up with Chef Nicolas where they cook up a seafood specialty which they then enjoy under the sun on the beach. With a reef nearby, Brent rents a glass bottomed kayak and paddles out to check out the sea life. Then hopping on a bicycle, he rides to a nearby market to get the ingredients he needs for his take on a Chef Nicolas's dish, Mauritian lobster rolls, which he prepares under shady palms.

programme.title: Brent Owens Unwraps Mauritius
programme.desc: Mauritius is covered in sugar cane plantations and Mauritian rum is growing fast on the international market. Brent heads to St Aubin, an estate with one of the oldest sugar cane fields and a factory that produces both artisanal and traditional rums. There he not only tastes the rum but learns all about making it too. It's a good thing he has nothing else planned that day. The next morning Brent visits a nearby market to buy his ingredients and then gets his adrenaline pumping with a wild tubing experience where he learns just how solid water is, again and again, and again. He then heads off on a sunset catamaran cruise where he cooks up a delicious caramel, rum, jerked chicken dish, finishing off the day with a rum cocktail. Is it the waves making him unsteady on his feet or all the rum?

programme.title: Brent Owens Unwraps Mauritius
programme.desc: Mauritians have a passion for tea. Their esteem and adoration almost match that of the British. Vanilla tea in particular, is a staple in Mauritian house-holds. Brent begins his journey into the history of this grand love affair at Bois Cheri Tea Factory, home to some of the oldest tea fields on the island. After learning how tea goes from a leafy bush to a brew-able bag he gets to experience the various flavours at a tea tasting with a view. Brent then meets up with a Mauritian local, Aurelie, at Flaq market to buy ingredients for a tea dish she is going to teach him. It's a beautiful day and, regardless of his fear of heights, Brent decides to fit in some parasailing before the cook. He then heads to Cap Malheureux where he and Aurelie cook her mother's tea chicken dish.

programme.title: Brent Owens Unwraps Mauritius
programme.desc: Brent looks back on his time in Mauritius. Everything he's learnt, the laughs, the people, the food. Co-existence amongst the Indian, African, European and Chinese locals has led to a sharing of cultures and values, giving the Mauritians a great sense of national pride and Brent can feel it. An island commonly associated with coconuts and cocktails is proven to be so much deeper and after being welcomed into homes, sacred places of worship and given family cooking secrets, Brent is left feeling like he is part of the Mauritian family.

programme.desc: Germana is an untalented and unlucky aspiring actress, a somewhat inconsiderate mother and the mistress of a rich lawyer who supports her financially. Elisabetta, her neighbour, on the other hand, is a successful doctor, too closed in her schemes to realise her husband is homosexual until she is left alone with many questions. When Gianmarco, a family man in a work crisis, saves Germana's daughter from an accident, sparks fly between them. Too bad she does not know that he is married and is Elisabetta's friend. Fate brings them face to face with reality when, during a holiday in Sicily, they all meet again, forcing them to confront each other.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: Have you ever been stuck on a frustrating medical merry-go-round, receiving wrong diagnosis after wrong diagnosis? The Doctors teach you how to avoid misinformation and how to get the best treatment right now!

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: The Doctors counts down the top five health scares. Learn when a headache can lead to a deadly stroke. And, 15 percent of pregnancies end in miscarriage. Dr. Lisa shares ways to prevent the heartbreaking loss.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: From lips and legs to labor and libido, The Doctors explores the “L” words everyone loves or loathes and gives you the tools to start feeling and looking your absolute best! And find out the best ways to fight lethargy.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: The Doctors blow the lid off America’s silent killer: salt. Learn how to take action and join the nationwide movement to Halt The Salt! And, NBA champ Magic Johnson explains the biggest fight of his life.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: HOLIDAY: Snowfall, family fun and holiday cheer make winter the most wonderful time of the year. Learn how to winterize your home, keep your little ones warm and protect your skin from the elements!

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: It's time for another round of the most embarrassing questions! Learn everything you've always wanted to know but were too afraid to ask - no subject is off-limits! And, learn how to get rid of those flabby arms once and for all!

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: Tone, tighten and sculpt your booty with celebrity trainer David Kirsch’s signature exercises! And, how to get rid of adult acne, eliminate crow’s feet and look a size smaller in less than 60 seconds!

programme.title: The Doctors

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: From a grumbling stomach, to a gassy gut to ringing ears, find out which body noises are hazardous, which are harmless and how to mute them.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.sub-title: What to Do if Disaster Strikes

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: Think you know what’s to blame for what’s ailing you? Bad skin? Must be the chocolate. Acid Reflux? Probably spicy food? Not so fast – The Doctors shed new light on common problems. Plus, how to get your body back after baby!

programme.desc: Having just moved from Beijing, elderly tai chi master Mr. Chu (Sihung Lung) struggles to adjust to life in New York, living with his Americanized son Alex (Ye-tong Wang). Chu immediately butts heads with his put-upon white daughter-in-law, Martha (Deb Snyder), a writer who seems to blame him for her own paralyzing inability to focus. But when Chu begins teaching tai chi at a local school, his desire to make a meaningful connection comes to fruition in the most unexpected of ways. PUSHING HANDS is the debut film from Oscar-winning director Ang Lee, forming the first chapter in his 'Father Knows Best' trilogy, which depicts the tensions between the traditional Confucian values of the older generation and the realities of modern life. Co-written by collaborator James Schamus, PUSHING HANDS was selected by the 1992 Berlin International Film Festival and won three Golden Horse Awards, paving the way for Lee's worldwide success with films such as CROUCHING TIGER, HIDDEN DRAGON and BROKEBACK MOUNTAIN. Presented in a new 2K restoration.

programme.title: Kabaneri of the Iron Fortress [English Subtitle]
programme.sub-title: Kabaneri of the Iron Fortress E10 [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: At a time when the industrial revolution was carrying the world into the modern age, a horde of undead monsters suddenly appeared. They could not be killed unless their hearts, which were protected by a layer of iron, were pierced. Humans bitten by them would come back as undead monsters themselves. These undead, which would later be known as "Kabane," exploded in population until they finally overran the world. The people of Hinomoto, a nation in the far east, built fortresses known as "stations" throughout the land that have allowed them to survive the threat of the Kabane. People can only travel between these stations using fortified steam locomotives known as "Hayajiro," and they have managed to stay alive by sharing resources in this way. Ikoma is a young steamsmith living at Aragane Station, a city that specializes in the manufacture of iron and steam engines. He is working on developing a unique anti-Kabane weapon called a "piercing gun" as he waits for his chance to prove his strength. Then, one day, a Hayajiro called the "Iron Fortress" makes its way through the front lines to arrive at Aragane Station. When Ikoma begins his usual maintenance routine, he sees a mysterious girl who is exempt from her Kabane inspection. That night, Ikoma sees the girl again and learns that her name is Mumei, but then an out-of-control Hayajiro overrun by Kabane charges into Aragane Station. The Kabane pour out of the train into Aragane Station. Ikoma races against the flow of the panicked residents, this time determined not to run away, but to defeat the Kabane with his piercing gun!

programme.sub-title: Kabaneri of the Iron Fortress E12 [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: At a time when the industrial revolution was carrying the world into the modern age, a horde of undead monsters suddenly appeared. They could not be killed unless their hearts, which were protected by a layer of iron, were pierced. Humans bitten by them would come back as undead monsters themselves. These undead, which would later be known as "Kabane," exploded in population until they finally overran the world. The people of Hinomoto, a nation in the far east, built fortresses known as "stations" throughout the land that have allowed them to survive the threat of the Kabane. People can only travel between these stations using fortified steam locomotives known as "Hayajiro," and they have managed to stay alive by sharing resources in this way. Ikoma is a young steamsmith living at Aragane Station, a city that specializes in the manufacture of iron and steam engines. He is working on developing a unique anti-Kabane weapon called a "piercing gun" as he waits for his chance to prove his strength. Then, one day, a Hayajiro called the "Iron Fortress" makes its way through the front lines to arrive at Aragane Station. When Ikoma begins his usual maintenance routine, he sees a mysterious girl who is exempt from her Kabane inspection. That night, Ikoma sees the girl again and learns that her name is Mumei, but then an out-of-control Hayajiro overrun by Kabane charges into Aragane Station. The Kabane pour out of the train into Aragane Station. Ikoma races against the flow of the panicked residents, this time determined not to run away, but to defeat the Kabane with his piercing gun!

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Camila fiercely defends herself from Roberto's aggression and tells Max what happened. Mother Isabel, to help Camila, confides to Ezequiel why Roberto is extorting her. Max pressures Camila to tell him the whole truth.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Roberto confesses that he was the one who killed Gabriel to frame Camila. Camila cries with joy, knowing she is innocent of that death. Max reiterates his unconditional support, ratifying his great love for her. Ezequiel expresses his intention to marry Camila.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Ezequiel, rejected by Camila, manipulates her with a new job offer as assistant to his daughter Julia, all to try to get her closer to him. Max trusts in Camila's love. Torrealba asks them to join forces to find Rosa Blanco.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Faced with Ezequiel's intentions, Octavia and Marcelina verbally attack Camila. Max proposes and Camila hesitates but agrees to marry him. At a dinner party, Ezequiel gathers his children and Camila will be the special guest of honor.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: At the dinner, the main topic will be Rosa Blanco. Ezequiel says that this woman was an opportunist who fell in love with and took advantage of his younger brother, Leoncio. Astrid offends by adding that she was a prostitute, guilty of the war between the two families because of her relationship with Augusto Aragón and also with Leoncio López.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Camila insists on knowing about her family relationship, she thinks she could be Max's cousin. Ezequiel wants to dispel the doubt that she could be his niece, he interrogates Mother Isabel who denies knowing it and also turns to Marcelina who confirms it. Camila protects Chantal, a girl who sells flowers.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Max and Camila in idyllic moments regardless of the outcome of the DNA. They continue their search for Rosa Blanco. Two parcels delivered by a messenger, one for the Lopez Mendez family and the other for the Aragon family, confirm the reappearance of El Doliente.

programme.desc: Determined to teach his spendthrift wife Lisa how to save money, Oliver insists that she learn about farming...by growing her own vegetables! In her own inimitable fashion, armed with useless pamphlets from Mr. Kimball, Lisa sets to tilling!

programme.desc: When handyman Eb (Tom Lester) reports he has seen little green men piloting flying saucers, everyone in Hooterville takes him at his word�even the Air Force�and soon the Douglas farm becomes the Roswell of the greater Pixley area!

programme.desc: Lisa weaves the tale of her great, great grandmother, the Queen of the Gypsies, to explain a bizarre family tradition: a woman in her family must marry an American -- but only every fourth generation -- in order to gain a special inheritance.

programme.title: Green Acres

programme.desc: Oliver finds himself in a jam after asking Lisa to make him homemade fruit preserves. An episode deliciously devoted to Lisa's culinary escapades, Lisa musters all of her Hungarian might to make Oliver the best peach jam he's ever tasted.

programme.desc: Lisa is reminded that she stored a birthday present for Oliver years ago: a genuine Stavinsky. But what is it? It's a modern art sculpture that is two parts plumbing pipes, one part tire chains, and one part birdbath. Oliver calls it "The Thing."

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: The continually evolving story of how Lisa (Eva Gabor) and Oliver (Oliver) fell in love gets yet another version in this delightful episode. But one thing is for sure: Lisa and Oliver are just as in love today as the day when he fell out of the sky.

programme.desc: Green Acres is greener than ever, with jealousy. When Oliver (Eddie Albert) hires a handsome, young, intelligent Brit to take over his farm work while he is away, it doesn't take long for the newcomer to make a strong impression on Lisa (Eva Gabor).

programme.title: Bandits (2023)
programme.desc: Strap yourself in for one hilarious action-comedy starring Bruce Willis, Billy Bob Thornton and Cate Blanchett! Convicts Joe (Willis) and Terry (Thornton) run an ingenious bank robbery scheme...until they meet an eccentric housewife (Blanchett).

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Attempting to deliver serum to a plague-stricken planet, a pilot (Eric McCormack) and his crew crash land on an unknown moon. Bitten by an alien spider while fixing the ship, the pilot's mind wanders between alternate realities…in The Outer Limits.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A woman unable to feel emotions gets a new lease on life when a brain implant allows her to experience feelings for the first time. But, when the implant malfunctions, driving her towards insanity, she is shocked at the real cause of her problems.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A remorseless, uncaring scientist (Stephen Lang) and his partner (Michael Ontkean) discover a way to bring life back to the recently deceased. But after the scientist is killed and brought back to life himself, will he choose to live differently?

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Brilliant geneticist Martin Nodel (Ron Rifkin) unlocks a secret code imprinted on human DNA. But when he tests this code on himself, his "instincts" draw him to a remote location where he finds a trip…to The Outer Limits. Ryan Reynolds co-stars.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: When it is not known if aliens headed to Earth are friend or foe, five people are placed in secret bunkers to man switches that, if not pressed at specified intervals, will set off mass destruction that will destroy everything, alien or human alike.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Engaged as soldiers on a distant planet to prevent a race of alien bugs from stealing minerals that provide the Earth's energy, a woman (Christine Elise) and her troops accidentally discover that the real enemy may not be the aliens at all.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: When a seemingly harmless audio signal from space causes physiological changes in Earth's youth, a young scientist races against time to discover what exactly is happening and why. Could the changes be necessary for the survival of the planet?

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A despondent man finds himself torn between killing himself and killing his co-workers. Before he can do either, he's pulled into The Outer Limits where there are hundreds of versions of him, each with a different life and a different character.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A woman's life changes dramatically when she accidentally shoots herself in the head which causes her to not only grow more intelligent, but also to realize how dull her life was before the photo in a picture frame started talking to her.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: When an incident at a space station leaves three people dead, the captain of the ship returns to Earth to face murder charges. Is the captain a murderous madman? Or has he actually seen the face of evil floating in the zero-gravity of deep space?

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: The residents of a suburban neighborhood have their lives turned upside down when a four block section of their subdivision is ripped from the earth by a mysterious force and transported to a distant planet. David McCallum and Laura Harris star.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Muckraking TV journalist Donald Rivers (Alan Thicke), host of "The Whole Truth," has the show of a lifetime: rock solid-proof that the government and private defense contractors have been engaging in secret genetic cloning.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Using an experimental treatment, a scientist (Pat Morita) helps an aging athlete (Adrian Pasdar) end his career on a high note by accelerating his reflexes for one last match. But with victory comes side-effects...courtesy of The Outer Limits.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: In a society controlled by aliens, a mother rebels when she is forced to give up her child to Mother, a wise alien who acts as a parent to all infants. Determined to get the child back, she embarks upon a dangerous quest that will change her world.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: When Genetic Engineering creates super-babies, some suffer from Genetic Rejection Syndrome (GRS), making them stronger and more deadly. A detective (Gary Cole) must stop his GRS son, a suspected killer, but must take a serum to become more like him.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Hunters pay to hunt androids that have a chip that keeps them from harming humans. However, secretly planted data allows the androids to disable the chip, and the balance of power shifts between men and machines! Starring Ron White and Doug Savant.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Xenobiologist Teresa Janovitch (Melissa Gilbert) is on a military team searching an uninhabited planet for minerals. When the team is attacked by aliens and a retaliation is successful, Janovitch makes a shocking discovery about the victims.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Reporter Judy Warren (Kate Vernon) tracks down Josh (Alex McArthur), a recluse who performs miracles. Alien or angel? All that Judy knows is that now the military is involved and she doesn’t trust them. If she can help Josh, will she find the truth?

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A medical specialist (Peter Flemming) examines a case involving an epidemic that killed a number of children in a small town. Through hypnosis, he probes the mind of a surviving child (Rachel Leigh Cook) and unravels a memory of "alien" proportions.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: As part of a top-secret program, the brain content of a military Captain (Lou Diamond Phillips) is temporarily transferred to an android to create a superior soldier. But, when things go wrong, can the transfer be reversed? Also starring Robert Joy.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A group of hospital patients and their nurse, Marie Alexander (Maria Conchita Alonso), survive a global, terrorist bio-attack. A vaccine arrives, but there are only three doses. Who will be chosen? Will it be survival of the fittest?

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Bernard (Ayre Gross) is haunted by images from his past and the tragic death of his sister...a death he caused. An experimental treatment brings positive results, but also a dangerous side effect: Bernard can now transfer his fear to others!

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: When a transport ship Captain (C. Thomas Howell) is rescued after surviving a devastating crash on Venus, strange things begin to happen when he returns to Earth. He did what it took to survive on Venus, but could the price of survival be too high?

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A scientist (Gregory Harrison) in a colony on another planet urges evacuation when he discovers that a radioactive star will soon pass over. He has been wrong before, though, and at great cost. Will the truth be accepted in time to save the colony?

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Charlie Bouton (Tom Butler) and Melburn Ross (Michael Shanks) create Mary 25, a nanny robot. When Bouton falls in love with Mary and mistreats his wife, a woman whom Ross once loved, the lines between human and machine become dangerously blurred.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A negotiator (Brett Cullen) tries to find out why a grad student (Peter Stebbings) is threatening to detonate a deadly, self-made bomb, unless the government kills five people for him. Why those five people? Is it revenge? And can he be stopped?

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Four telekinetic people are recruited by the CIA, who hopes to use their talents to assassinate a war criminal. Their powers produce unexpected side-effects; however, and the killers may soon find that they are the prey. Robert Guillaume stars.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: When Dr. Nodel (Ron Rifkin) is joined on an alien ship by a small group of students to communicate with aliens, it appears that they’ve all been led into a trap. Have the aliens led them astray? Ryan Reynolds also stars. Sequel to “Double Helix”

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Dr. Marvin P. Gunderson is summoned to examine Kitty Kat, the ailing lion pet of the Addams Family. Morticia decides that it is the doctor who needs help. To build his confidence, human members of the family pretend to be ill so he can affect cures.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's concern that Lurch is overworked leads Gomez to the operating table to assemble a custom-built secondary butler. Lurch lets the robot do all the work and then begins to feel that he isn't needed anymore.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Uncle Fester incinerates the family's stuffed bear with his flamethrower, Morticia reports the accident to the insurance company. Mr. Henson, the head of the company, sends his assistant, Mr. Digby, to handle the case.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch suffers from unrequited love over Tiny Trivia (guest star Diane Jergens), Morticia's visiting school chum who only has eyes for show business. The entire family decides to try to turn their stolid butler in to a new personality.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Ophelia laments that she has been jilted, Morticia suggests a career as an alternative to marriage. She tries chemistry first (with explosive results) then turns to operatic singing. Cousin Itt is summoned to coach her to stardom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Goes To School
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez decide to keep Wednesday and Pugsley home from school after Morticia sees the fairy tales they have to read. When the truant officer comes to investigate, he is shocked at what he finds.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia calls a psychiatrist after she fears Pugsley is becoming normal after he abandons his pet octopus for a puppy and is seen wearing a Boy Scout uniform, playing with a baseball bat, and helping an old lady cross the street.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester, who has become lonely, convinces Gomez and Morticia that it is time for him to find a bride. He decides to put an ad in the newspaper, looking for love. But things go awry when a door-to-door saleswoman comes by.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Election fever grips the Addams household, as Gomez (John Astin) supports the council candidate whose campaign promise is to drain the town's disgusting bogs. Morticia (Carolyn Jones), who likes "the lovely bogs," labels the candidate an extremist.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley and Wednesday start a row at a party when their gift of a tarantula upsets Harold, the birthday boy. Harold's parents insist that the Addams children lack breeding and, therefore, are no longer allowed to play with their son.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Pugsley befriends Gorgo, a circus gorilla, Gorgo decides to follow Pugsley and Gomez home, where he is accepted as one of the family. But Gorgo gives Morticia's tea guests, the Ladies League members, quite a shock.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A pair of bank robbers are welcomed as Halloween trick-or-treaters by Morticia and Gomez. The creepy atmosphere of the house, Morticia's smoldering holiday punch and Lurch's ominous presence impel the crooks to abandon their plans.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Lionel Barker, a former suitor of Morticia, shows up, Gomez is jealous. But he's soon calmed when he learns that Barker is after Mildred, the new maid. The Addamses then discover that Barker is a con man--after Mildred's money, not her love.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: New Neighbors Meet The Addams Family
programme.desc: Newlyweds move in next door. But the honeymoon loses its tranquility when Uncle Fester enters their house through a tunnel and they flee in terror at the sight of Lurch, Grandmama sharpening her ax, and Morticia and Gomez bathing the octopus.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family faces a crisis when Wednesday packs her spider and runs away (after being scolded for playing with Uncle Fester's TNT). When they try to file a missing person report, a detective is anxious to retire early due to their story.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Meets The V.I.P.'s
programme.desc: Official visitors from an unfriendly nation receive the shock of their lives when they decide to exploit the Addams Family as an average uncultured family. The visitors are shaken up by Morticia's carnivorous plants among other things.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's cousin, Melancholia, wants to marry Clarence P. Harvey after most of her marital prospects have joined the Foreign Legion. Clarence recoils when Melancholia puts on a campaign to win him, backed by Morticia, Gomez and Clarence's boss.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes a veritable gazelle when he takes dancing lessons at Gomez and Morticia's suggestion, after he admits to being a wallflower at social functions. Each member of the Addams Family teaches Lurch a different step.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama's paintings leave an art critic speechless, so Gomez sends for his friend, Sam Picasso, to teach Grandmama to paint in the abstract. The starving artist ignores Grandmama's and Morticia's work as he eats and paints.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Meets A Beatnik
programme.desc: Rockland Cartright III is a beatnik who crashes his motorbike into a tree and recuperates at the Addams house. Each regards the other as an oddity, although the family learns to appreciate certain aspects of Rockland's life.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Meets The Undercover Man
programme.desc: Mr. Briggs, the postman, is hired by the government to do undercover work in the Addams house. While pretending to be a stamp collector, he investigates rumors that coded radio messages are being sent from the house.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: Mother Lurch Visits The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch's tiny fire-eating mother visits and demands that Lurch's employers wait on her boy hand-and-foot after Lurch leads her to believe that it's his house. Lurch revels in the unexpected attention he gets from Morticia and Gomez.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's electrical output fails abruptly. Should they call a doctor or an electrician to bring Fester back? Morticia prescribes a bowl of porcupine mold, and both she an Gomez agree that long exposure to moon rays would be beneficial.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family would like to vacation on the moon, but the billion dollar travel cost is slightly prohibitive. Uncle Fester volunteers $21.13 and Morticia, using Gomez's new supercomputer, suggests placing a $2,000 bet on the daily double horse race.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: Cousin Itt Visits The Addams Family
programme.desc: Cousin Itt is advocated as curator of the local zoo. Gomez uses his influence with Park Commissioner Fisk (guest star Alan Reed) to promote Itt for the job, but the zookeepers are convinced the Addamses' cousin should be confined to a cage.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama (Blossom Rock) is hauled off to jail for setting up a fortune-telling booth in the Addamses' living room. Gomez (John Astin) volunteers to act as attorney, and the court session becomes a shambles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez (John Astin) loses his memory after hitting his head; he fails to recognize Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and says the house looks like a condemned museum. The Addamses take turns hitting Gomez on the head trying to help him regain his memory.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Thing disappears from his box. Failing to find a single trace of Thing, Gomez (John Astin) conducts an investigation--with all members of the household under suspicion. Also starring Carolyn Jones, Jackie Coogan, and Ted Cassidy.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester applies for a job as an insurance salesman with the same company which is threatening to cancel the Addamses' policy (because Fester keeps blowing things up). Fester convinces the company interviewer that he is qualified for the job.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes inconsolable when Gomez donates the family antique harpsichord to a collector. Gomez and Morticia offer Lurch a balalaika and a set of drums. When this proves unsatisfactory, Gomez and Fester decide to build a new harpsichord.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Morticia hears the stock market has crashed, she assumes that Gomez has been financially wiped out and rallies the family to help make money. Morticia gives lessons, Lurch and Fester run an escort service, and the kids run a poison drink stand.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family And The Spaceman
programme.desc: While enjoying a moonlight picnic and snail hunt, the Addams Family is mistaken for Martians by uniformed investigators from Mysterious Space Objects Headquarters. In turn, Gomez (John Astin) and the clan regard their inquisitors with suspicion.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: An organ grinder's fugitive monkey leads Fester to believe that he has turned Pugsley into a monkey. Morticia and Gomez treat the monkey as though he were their son, welcoming him to the dinner table and giving him Pugsley's chores.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Moriticia's favorite charity is having an auction--so Morticia persuades her family to part with things to sell. Donations include Wednesday's headless doll, the old flogging table, a stuffed vulture and Uncle Fester's dynamite.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The Addams Family ignores notices that their house is to be condemned to make way for a freeway. When sudden explosions cannot be traced to any member of the family but, instead, to city workmen, Gomez is forced to consider moving the house.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's pen pal, Madelyn, is coming to visit. Fester panics, as he has described himself as handsome, heroic and romantic. Gomez and Morticia agree that all Fester needs is a toupee and they help him make several styles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: Cousin Itt And The Vocational Counselor
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez are worried about Cousin Itt because he spends his days sleeping and dreaming in his tiny room. They decide that Itt would make an excellent marriage counselor, and pretend to be a couple with a failing marriage.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A recording company's platter of Lurch's gravelly voice brings a screaming mob of teenage fans to the Addams house. To calm the crowd, Lurch seats himself at the harpsichord and rewards his fans with a song to end all songs.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Taken in by a psychologist's pronouncement that the only happily married couples are those who fight, members of the Addams household devise schemes to start a battle between Gomez (John Astin) and Morticia (Carolyn Jones).

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez decides to bolster Cousin Itt's failing ego by making him the star of a production aimed as a birthday surprise for Wednesday. He hires the great director, Eric von Bissell, who gives Itt elocution lessons, causing a Hollywood star complex.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: While Morticia and Gomez are celebrating their 13th wedding anniversary, she tells Wednesday and Pugsley a bedtime story of how she and Gomez first met. In this episode, Carolyn Jones plays Morticia, Morticia as a 22-year-old, and sister Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley refuse to go to bed until they hear the rest of the courtship story. Morticia resumes the tale via flashback, including the ceremony beginning with Ophelia Frump, Morticia's balmy sister, as the bride.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Romance seems close for Thing, the Addams right-hand-in-a-box, when Gomez's aunt arrives for a visit accompanied by Lady Fingers, her handmaiden. Thing enjoys the visit most because it gives him a chance to hold hands with one of his own kind.

programme.title: The Addams Family

programme.title: The Addams Family

programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley return in tears from trick-or-treating because a neighbor has told them there is no such thing as a witch. Morticia and Gomez plan to prove to the children that they do exist--by summoning a witch to a séance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Determined to correct the dreadful literature that Wednesday and Pugsley are exposed to, Morticia sets out to create a new literary world. Gomez fears that his wife's first manuscript is so good, that once the publisher reads it, he will lose her.

programme.title: The Addams Family

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley copies one of his dad's old love letters and sends it to his teacher. Miss Dunbar comes to visit the Addams home and confesses to Gomez that no man has ever fallen so in love with her, leading Morticia to pretend to be the jealous wife.

programme.title: Flower Crew: Joseon Marriage Agency
programme.sub-title: Flower Crew: Joseon Marriage Agency episode 1
programme.desc: Flower Crew, Joseon's top matchmaking agency, consists of Ma Hoon, Young Soo, and Do Joon. While working on a case, they meet Gae Ttong. Soon after, blacksmith Kim Soo asks Flower Crew for help.

programme.title: Flower Crew: Joseon Marriage Agency
programme.sub-title: Flower Crew: Joseon Marriage Agency episode 2
programme.desc: Flower Crew agrees to arrange Gae Ttong and Soo's wedding. Everything goes smoothly until Soo suddenly disappears. Gae Ttong and Hoon set out to find him, but their search seems hopeless.

programme.title: Flower Crew: Joseon Marriage Agency
programme.sub-title: Flower Crew: Joseon Marriage Agency episode 3
programme.desc: Hoon allows Gae Ttong to join Flower Crew as a three-month apprentice. After losing clients, the crew takes a case involving scholar Lee Hyung Gyu, but Hoon suspects he is hiding something.

programme.title: Flower Crew: Joseon Marriage Agency
programme.sub-title: Flower Crew: Joseon Marriage Agency episode 4
programme.desc: Hoon lets Gae Ttong stay at the house again, and subtle feelings grow between them. Gae Ttong promises to leave if she fails to persuade Scholar Lee. Meanwhile, Soo orders an investigation into the Crown Prince's murder.

programme.title: Flower Crew: Joseon Marriage Agency
programme.sub-title: Flower Crew: Joseon Marriage Agency episode 5
programme.desc: Hoon is taken to the palace and discovers that Soo is now the king. Soo asks him to protect Gae Ttong. Meanwhile, Gae Ttong volunteers to pose as a noble lady to help Flower Crew with Scholar Lee's marriage.

programme.title: Flower Crew: Joseon Marriage Agency
programme.sub-title: Flower Crew: Joseon Marriage Agency episode 6
programme.desc: Hoon is flustered by Gae Ttong's unexpected kiss, but she remembers nothing the next morning. Meanwhile, Scholar Lee asks her to deliver his napchae documents to his bride's home, but she refuses.

programme.title: Flower Crew: Joseon Marriage Agency
programme.sub-title: Flower Crew: Joseon Marriage Agency episode 7
programme.desc: The Rogue dies mysteriously in prison, leaving Hoon with the words "Fox Guard." Hoon and Joon search for the killer. Meanwhile, Gae Ttong reunites with her brother Kang, raising Ji Hwa's suspicions.

programme.title: Flower Crew: Joseon Marriage Agency
programme.sub-title: Flower Crew: Joseon Marriage Agency episode 8
programme.desc: Soo finally reunites with Gae Ttong and promises to marry her. However, Hoon realizes he has feelings for her. Meanwhile, his investigation into the Rogue's death leads him closer to the truth.

programme.title: Flower Crew: Joseon Marriage Agency
programme.sub-title: Flower Crew: Joseon Marriage Agency episode 9

programme.title: Una Trampa del Tiempo
